---DEP_AAS AND CUST DIM
IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'D360' AND TABLE_NAME = 'DEP_AAS_CUSTDIM_hash')
    DROP TABLE D360.DEP_AAS_CUSTDIM_hash;

CREATE TABLE D360.DEP_AAS_CUSTDIM_hash
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(ACID)
    ,HEAP--CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
AS
SELECT 
     AAS.AS_OF_DATE
    ,AAS.ACID
    ,AAS.BANK_ID
    ,CUST.ORGKEY
FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP AAS
INNER JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON AAS.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
    AND AAS.CUST_ID = CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
    AND CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
WHERE AAS.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'

----HTD_APRIL
IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'D360' AND TABLE_NAME = 'DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_April')
    DROP TABLE D360.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_April;

CREATE TABLE D360.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_April
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(ACID)
    ,HEAP--CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
AS
SELECT
     HTD.ACID
    ,HTD.TRAN_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
    ,HTD.TRAN_DATE
    ,HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_AMT
    ,HTD.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP 
    ,HTD.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
    ,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE
    ,HTD.SOL_ID
    ,HTD.SOURCE_CODE
    ,HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR
    ,HTD.TRAN_RMKS
    ,HTD.LCHG_TIME
    ,HTD.RCRE_TIME
    ,HTD.PSTD_DATE
    ,HTD.BANK_ID
    ,DAC.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
	,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY HTD.ACID) SK
    FROM (
        SELECT
         HTD.ACID
        ,HTD.TRAN_ID
        ,HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
        ,HTD.TRAN_DATE
        ,HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE
        ,HTD.TRAN_AMT
        ,CASE WHEN HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN HTD.TRAN_AMT 
            ELSE HTD.TRAN_AMT * CC.ConversionRate END AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP
        --,1 TRAN_CNT
        ,HTD.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
        ,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE
        ,HTD.SOL_ID
        ,HTD.SOURCE_CODE
        ,HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR
        ,HTD.TRAN_RMKS
        ,HTD.LCHG_TIME
        ,HTD.RCRE_TIME
        ,HTD.PSTD_DATE
        ,HTD.BANK_ID
        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY HTD.ACID, HTD.TRAN_ID, HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM, HTD.TRAN_DATE  ORDER BY HTD.[FILE_NAME] DESC, HTD.INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN
        FROM [EDS].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE] HTD
        LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV') CC
            ON HTD.BANK_ID = CC.FinancialInstitutionId
            AND HTD.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId
            AND HTD.TRAN_DATE = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
        WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
        AND TRAN_DATE BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-04-30'
    ) HTD
JOIN D360.DEP_AAS_CUSTDIM_hash DAC
    ON HTD.ACID = DAC.ACID
    AND HTD.TRAN_DATE = DAC.AS_OF_DATE
    AND HTD.BANK_ID = DAC.BANK_ID
WHERE HTD.RN = 1

IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'D360' AND TABLE_NAME = 'DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_LOAD')
   CREATE TABLE [d360].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_LOAD]
( 
	[ACID] [varchar](30)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_ID] [varchar](9)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_SERIAL_NUMBER] [varchar](4)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_DATE] [date]  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_AMOUNT] [numeric](20,4)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_PHP] [numeric](20,4)  NULL,
	[INITIALIZING_BRANCH_CODE] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_TYPE] [char](1)  NULL,
	[BRANCH_CODE] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_PARTICULAR] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[TRANSACTION_REMARKS] [varchar](30)  NULL,
	[CHANGED_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[CREATED_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[POSTED_DATE] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[FCBSCIF] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[SK] [bigint] IDENTITY 
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
);

TRUNCATE TABLE [d360].[DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CI_LOAD];
